lessons.principle_en: Make inferences — what is implied but not directly stated?
lessons.principle_ar: استنتج المعلومات — ما الذي يُلمَّح إليه دون ذكره صراحةً؟
lessons.strategy_ar: اقرأ بين السطور: نبرة المتحدث، اختياره للكلمات، وما لم يُقَل قد يكون أهم من المُصرَّح.

lines: I wanted to ask about scholarship options.
Most are merit-based. What's your current GPA?
That qualifies you for several. Let me show you the list.
I'm considering applying for a student loan, but I'm a bit nervous.
I understand. What concerns you most?
Repayment after graduation. I'm not sure I'll find a job right away.
That's a valid concern, but our loans have a six-month grace period after graduation.
Six months? That's helpful, but still feels tight.
If you face hardship, you can apply for income-based repayment.
So payments adjust to my actual salary?
Exactly. Many graduates use this option in their first year.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the student?
options: She is anxious about future finances
questions.explanation_ar: كلمات مثل 'nervous' و'not sure I'll find a job' تكشف القلق المالي رغم عدم تصريحها مباشرةً.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لا يوجد دليل على الثراء أو وجود وظيفة.

questions.q: What is implied about the income-based repayment?
options: It's commonly used by new graduates
questions.explanation_ar: قال 'Many graduates use this option in their first year' — يُلمح لكونه شائعاً.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لم يُذكر أنه نادر أو طارئ.

clips.context_ar: طالب يستفسر عن تأخر دفعة منحته
lines: I'm still waiting for my scholarship deposit. It was due last week.
Let me check your file. I see your paperwork is complete.
It appears the bank verification took longer than usual this semester.
Will this affect my ability to pay tuition on time?
Don't worry. We've flagged your account so no late fees apply.
That's a relief. When can I expect the deposit?

questions.q: What can be inferred about the delay?
options: It is a wider administrative issue this semester
questions.explanation_ar: ذكرت 'bank verification took longer than usual this semester' — مشكلة عامة وليس فردية.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: أوراق الطالب مكتملة، ولم يُلغَ شيء.

questions.q: Why won't the student face late fees?
options: His account has been flagged due to the delay
questions.explanation_ar: قالت 'We've flagged your account so no late fees apply' — حماية إدارية مؤقتة.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لم يدفع شيئاً ولم يُلغَ القسط.

lessons.principle_en: Predict what the speaker will do next based on context.
lessons.principle_ar: تنبأ بما سيفعله المتحدث لاحقاً اعتماداً على السياق.
lessons.strategy_ar: في آخر جملتين، يلمح المتحدث لخطوته التالية. اربط الكلمات مع النية.

lines: Yes, our advisors do that. Have you booked an appointment?
You can book online or stop by tomorrow.
I have a job interview next Tuesday. Could you help me prepare?
Certainly. Have you researched the company?
Briefly. I know they're in renewable energy.
Go deeper. Look at their recent projects and leadership.
We offer mock interviews. Would you like to schedule one for Friday?
Yes, that would be amazing. I'll prepare more research first.
Bring your notes Friday and we'll do a full simulation.

questions.q: What will the student most likely do before Friday?
questions.explanation_ar: قالت 'I'll prepare more research first' و طُلب منها التعمق في الشركة.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: المقابلة الحقيقية يوم الثلاثاء التالي، وليس هناك إشارة لتقديم لوظائف أخرى.

questions.q: What will happen during the Friday meeting?
questions.explanation_ar: ذكر 'we'll do a full simulation' — مقابلة تجريبية.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: ليست مقابلة حقيقية، فقط تجريبية.

clips.context_ar: طالب يستفسر عن معرض التوظيف القادم
lines: I want to attend the upcoming career fair, but I've never been to one.
Good first step. The fair has over 80 companies this year.
Business attire is expected. Also bring at least ten copies of your CV.
Ten copies? That sounds like a lot.
It goes quickly. Some students leave with leads from five or six companies.
What if I don't know what to say at the booths?
We have a pre-fair workshop next Wednesday. I'd strongly recommend attending.

questions.q: What will the student most likely do next?
questions.explanation_ar: نصيحة قوية 'I'd strongly recommend attending' تجعل الحضور هو الخطوة المنطقية التالية.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لا يوجد ما يدل على التخلي عن الفكرة.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: اربط النصيحة القوية بسلوك الطالب المتوقع.

questions.q: What does the speaker imply about CVs?
questions.explanation_ar: قال 'It goes quickly' و'leads from five or six companies' — يُلمح إلى استهلاك سريع للنسخ.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: العكس مذكور صراحةً: 10 نسخ تنفد بسرعة.

lessons.principle_en: Follow the flow of ideas across multiple turns.
lessons.principle_ar: تابع تسلسل الأفكار عبر تبادلات متعددة.
lessons.strategy_ar: تتبع المنطق: المشكلة → التشخيص → الحل → التأكيد. كل خطوة تبني على ما قبلها.

clips.context_ar: مقطع تمهيدي عن طلب مساعدة تقنية
lines: My laptop won't connect to the campus Wi-Fi.
Did you reset your network settings?
Try that first, then come back if it doesn't work.
I forgot my email password and can't reset it.
Did you try the recovery email option?
Yes, but the recovery email is also my old high school account, which is closed.
That's the problem. We'll need to verify your identity manually.
Come to the IT desk with your student ID and a second photo ID.
About fifteen minutes. After verification, we'll reset your password immediately.

questions.q: Why couldn't the student reset his password online?
options: His recovery email account is closed
questions.explanation_ar: السبب المنطقي: 'recovery email is also my old high school account, which is closed'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: بقية الأسباب لم تُذكر.

questions.q: What is the solution proposed?
options: Manual identity verification at IT desk
questions.explanation_ar: اقترحت 'verify your identity manually' في مكتب الدعم.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لا حاجة لإنشاء حساب جديد أو الانتظار.

clips.context_ar: طالبة تواجه مشكلة في برنامج جامعي
lines: The statistics software keeps crashing whenever I open large data sets.
Have you checked the system requirements?
Yes, my laptop meets them, but barely.
That might be the issue. The software needs significantly more RAM for big files.
Is there a solution that doesn't involve buying a new laptop?
You can access the same software remotely through our computer lab servers.
Really? That would be perfect for my thesis work.
I'll send you the login instructions and remote access guide via email.

questions.q: What is the root cause of the crashes?
questions.explanation_ar: حدد بوضوح 'The software needs significantly more RAM for big files'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: بقية الأسباب لم تُذكر كمصدر مباشر.
questions.elimination_hint_ar: السبب التقني الذي تشخّص في الحوار.

questions.q: What is the proposed workaround?
options: Access software remotely via lab servers
questions.explanation_ar: اقترح 'access the same software remotely through our computer lab servers'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: الحل تجنب شراء جهاز جديد.

lessons.principle_en: Track decision-making — how does the speaker reach a conclusion?
lessons.principle_ar: تتبع اتخاذ القرار — كيف يصل المتحدث إلى استنتاج؟
lessons.strategy_ar: في حوارات الإرشاد، ابحث عن: الخيارات، الإيجابيات والسلبيات، ثم القرار النهائي.

lines: Both are valuable. Let's compare them based on your career goals.
I'm considering studying abroad next semester, but I'm hesitant.
I'm worried about delaying my graduation.
Many courses transfer back. Have you looked at partner universities?
Some, but the credit transfer rules are confusing.
Let's identify three programs where most credits transfer easily.
That would help. If credits transfer, I think I'd commit.
Then let's start there. I'll send program details tomorrow.

questions.q: What is the main factor influencing the student's decision?
questions.explanation_ar: ذكرت قلقها من 'delaying my graduation' وأن نقل الكريديت سيحسم القرار.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: بقية العوامل لم تُذكر كعقبات.

questions.q: What will the advisor do next?
options: Send her details of three suitable programs
questions.explanation_ar: وعد بـ 'send program details tomorrow' لثلاثة برامج محددة.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لا تسجيل فوري أو إلغاء.

lines: I've been thinking about taking a leave of absence next semester.
That's a big decision. What's prompting it?
Burnout. I've taken heavy course loads for three semesters straight.
Have you considered a reduced course load instead?
I thought of that, but I really need a complete break.
Understood. A leave can be granted, but you'll need to formally re-enroll later.
It pauses during your leave and resumes when you return, if you maintain good standing.

questions.q: Why is the student considering a leave?
questions.explanation_ar: ذكر 'Burnout. I've taken heavy course loads for three semesters'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: السبب أكاديمي/نفسي وليس مالياً أو عائلياً.

questions.q: What happens to his scholarship during the leave?
options: It pauses and resumes upon return
questions.explanation_ar: وضحت 'It pauses during your leave and resumes when you return'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: ليس إلغاءً ولا سداداً.

lessons.principle_en: Apply all skills together — main idea, details, tone, inference, and prediction.
lessons.principle_ar: طبّق كل المهارات معاً — الفكرة الرئيسية، التفاصيل، النبرة، الاستنتاج، والتنبؤ.
lessons.strategy_ar: في هذا الدرس، استخدم كل ما تعلمته. اقرأ السؤال بدقة لتحدد أي مهارة يختبرها.

lines: Professor, I have some questions about the final project.
Sure, what would you like to know?
First, can we work in pairs?
Yes, pairs are encouraged this time.

clips.context_ar: طالبة تناقش متطلبات مشروع متعدد المراحل
lines: Professor, my research project has more variables than I expected.
That's common. Can you narrow your scope?
I tried, but reducing variables might weaken my conclusions.
What if you split it into two phases? Phase one explores; phase two confirms.
That sounds manageable. Would phase two be next semester?
Possibly, depending on your phase-one findings.
I like that approach. It feels more rigorous.
Excellent. Submit a revised proposal by Friday outlining both phases.

questions.q: What is the main concern of the student?
options: Her project has too many variables
questions.explanation_ar: ذكرت 'my research project has more variables than I expected'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: ليست قلة بيانات، بل كثرة متغيرات.

questions.q: What is the professor's suggested approach?
options: Split the project into two phases
questions.explanation_ar: اقترح 'split it into two phases'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: بقية الخيارات ضد توجيه الأستاذ.

clips.context_ar: طالب يطعن في درجة مع نبرة محترمة لكن قلقة
lines: Professor, may I discuss the grading on my essay?
Of course. What specifically concerns you?
I lost six points on the analysis section, but I'm not clear on the criteria.
Let me explain. Your argument was solid, but you relied heavily on one source.
I see. I focused on depth over breadth.
Both matter in academic writing. Try diversifying sources in your next paper.
Is there any chance to revise this essay?
Not for a grade change, but I'm happy to discuss revisions for your learning.

questions.q: What can be inferred about the student's tone?
questions.explanation_ar: استخدامه لـ 'may I' و'I see' يدل على الاحترام، بينما القلق ظاهر من الاستفسار.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لا توجد علامات غضب أو سخرية.

questions.q: What will most likely happen next?
options: The student will discuss revisions for learning, not grades
questions.explanation_ar: وضحت 'Not for a grade change, but I'm happy to discuss revisions for your learning'.
questions.wrong_explanation_ar: لا تغيير في الدرجة ولا إجراء عقابي.
